exerciseSettings.sessions: Four fresh user-mediated sessions: baseline A, baseline B, post A, post B; no automatic agents or paid model API.
exerciseSettings.functionalMode: Memory and narrow DynamoDB/marker SDK contract doubles; no Docker/live service required by these paired task suites. Iteration live acceptance is separate.
exerciseSettings.modelPolicy: Phase-0 client does not expose an exact model/settings identifier. Before baseline A, record the user-agreed visible model label, reasoning setting and tool access; use the same for all four where possible and disclose deviations.
exerciseSettings.toolPolicy: Same Codex client/tool access, Node/pnpm/lockfile, task fixtures and active budget; record actual versions/settings in each session result.
exerciseSettings.timing: Visible session start/end minus union of recorded bounded install waits; ordinary test/tool duration remains active. No inferred thinking/CPU time.
exerciseSettings.tokens: Unavailable unless client exposes actual usage; never estimate.
exerciseSettings.coordination: Packet readiness is not baseline completion. Freeze agreed visible session settings and review both baseline observations before Phase 1.

rules.primary: Unique physical lines containing nontrivia TypeScript tokens inside selected AST spans, minus excluded subtrees; shared lines count once.
rules.formatting: Repository Prettier; freeze formatting before counting. Types and punctuation inside selected runtime modules count, imports count only when the file is selected.
rules.contextualTokens: Installed TypeScript scanner with parser-provided regex/template/JSX token boundaries; whitespace-only token lines do not count.
rules.excluded: Tests, docs, comments, whitespace, build output and explicitly identified domain subtrees. App-maintained generated runtime source counts.
rules.post: All remaining/renamed/moved generic protocol code plus replacing thin composition across the whole consumer, not just old filenames. Review generated code and app-to-app copies.
rules.denominator: selected-protocol only; separate-lab is disclosed separately and cannot inflate the 50% protocol retirement gate.
rules.apiGrowth: Freeze all framework src hashes/token-lines, package export maps and declared index export names/statements. This is not a semantic concept count; manually review star exports, new subpaths and concept burden at final audit.

files.reason: Invocation scope, bounded winner lookup and pinned core replay. Registry/source and calls to the domain claim validator are thin composition, counted before and after; validator implementation is excluded by not selecting its file.

Scope validation, normalized projection/transaction planning, logical expiry and atomic auxiliary mechanics. Fixed command receipt schema/key/construction and publication attempt decisions remain app-owned; their integration calls are counted as composition.
Scoped idempotency, serialized staging/atomic publication and auxiliary collisions; includes thin record-type composition.
Strong scoped lookups, logical TTL, transaction submission and conflict classification.

Failure history schema, IDs/fingerprints, replay construction, CAS invariants, projection/query and atomic memory failure/outbox storage. Consumer names/source/projection settings count as composition.
Durable collection/authorization/inspection/replay orchestration excluding editor identity policy, publication reconciliation and publisher retry restriction. Hook call sites remain composition.

excludes.reason: Publication authority, leases and domain reconciliation command.

files.reason: Bounded fanout/retry, marker cache, terminal collection and admission/cursor mechanics.

Whole-batch fixed-ARN/identity validation and normalization; current queue suffix map counts as thin composition and its replacement must count too.
Transport binding/pre-marker validation/authorization, excluding app-specific Lambda composition and entrypoints.

Consumer subscription validation and recovery wrapper around domain handlers. Domain materialization/publication/notification branches excluded; small remaining handler call/completion sites count as composition.

excludes.reason: Notification rendering/business sink and completion integration.

files.reason: Envelope/replay normalization and strict registry/schema checks; application target selection/identity predicate excluded. Current source/enums/schema references count as configuration.
Selected failure view schemas only; publication/notification DTOs remain domain-owned. Existing enum labels count as configuration.
Bounded drain-until-idle only. Other app composition/clock/services remain outside denominator; replacing selected protocols' composition must still count after migration.
Local transport/client safety; separate tooling disclosure, not protocol denominator.
